physical_setup.units: c=4pi=B0=L=1; L is transverse length, not long x-box length
physical_setup.boundaries: periodic x and z; unlike the paper absorbing x boundary; main packet does not wrap in displayed interval

pulse.profile: 0.3 sin(2pi*14*d) exp[-(d/.75)^6]; d is x/L-1 wrapped into [-2.5,2.5)
pulse.FFE_PIC: physical Bz=1+f, Ey=f, vx=f/(1+f), rho/rho0=sqrt(1+2f), p/p0=(rho/rho0)^gamma; finite-inertia PIC start is a force-free-limit wave
pulse.MHD: exact perpendicular SRMHD simplewave Riemann invariant; same lab magnetic pulse, model-dependent electric field and speed

alfven_seeds.resonance_note: All pairs have sum k=(14,0). kz7 is exactly resonant in FFE and nearest the revised beta0.1,cold-sigma10 MHD resonance kz=7*sqrt(16/15)=7.22957; kz8 brackets the inertial PIC daughter frequency. The original shared families7/8/9,40pairs and phases are unchanged. Shared seeds do not imply all pairs exactly resonant in every model.
alfven_seeds.nonlinear_constraints: Alfven transverse velocity divided by local guide compression; E=-v cross B includes finite-amplitude cross terms; Bx=0, Bz depends x, By depends x,z so divergence B=0.

PIC.psi_definition: E_AW,st/E_F0; E_AW,st=q n_total/k_perp in c=4pi=1, n_total includes both pair species
PIC.reference_convention: RMS kperp over all 80 equal-amplitude traveling daughter waves
PIC.temperature_note: PIC uses Maxwell-Juttner species; gamma-law initial enthalpy1.25 differs slightly from exact MJ enthalpy at theta.1; conduction drifts also add kinetic stress.
PIC.initial_current: FFE spatial current: J=rho_charge*(E cross B)/B^2 + [(B dot curlB - E dot curlE)/B^2]*B; replaces independent phase-transport derivative current only in PIC loading
PIC.species_loading: Common E cross B drift with equal/opposite parallel velocities; N=gamma(v_d)*rho/rho0, Nplus/minus=(N plus/minus rho_charge/C)/2, Vplus/minus=v_d plus/minus (J/C-rho_charge*v_d/C)/N. Exact charge/current; net parallel matter flux is determined by streams, not forced to zero.

MHD.solver: Athena++ SRMHD HLLE, RK3, PPM, CFL.25
MHD.interpretation: Finite-inertia compressibility and strong-pulse steepening are model differences; changes in the compressive EM projection can include fast and slow components and are not a direct heating measurement.

physical_setup.comparability: Shared magnetic pulse and seed pattern; model-dependent electric fields, currents, thermodynamics, and dispersion. MHD uses cold sigma10 and beta0.1; FFE and PIC are unchanged. Production illustration without a convergence campaign.

MHD.collocation: Cell-centered Bcc; SR four-velocity converted to three-velocity; E=-v cross B; native (x,z,-y) rotated to physical (x,y,z)

FFE.collocation: Carpet cell-centred native xy plane; physical x-z; coordinate mask removes all ghosts; native BvecFF and DvecFF=E in Minkowski

PIC.collocation: Native B advanced diagnostically by a half Faraday step to E time; Yee-to-cell arithmetic interpolation; Cartesian physical rotation (native1,-native3,native2)

charge_constraints.interpretation: Initial absolute Gauss offsets are retained. Small subsequent drift or filtered continuity residual does not imply the initial Gauss constraint was exact. Raw and filtered residuals use different explicitly recorded charge normalizations.

curve_normalization: Each model's own initial low-pass compressive electromagnetic polarization norm
projection_interpretation: The compressive projection includes both fast and slow magnetosonic modes in MHD. These EM diagnostics omit matter energy and are not heating measurements.
